q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT b1.name, COUNT(f1.drinker), AVG(s1.price), MIN(MostFrequent.drinker) FROM bar AS b1, serves AS s1, frequents AS f1, (SELECT bar, MIN(drinker) AS drinker FROM frequents AS f4 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM frequents AS f2 WHERE f2.times_a_week > f4.times_a_week AND f4.bar = f2.bar) GROUP BY bar) AS MostFrequent WHERE f1.bar = b1.name AND s1.bar = b1.name AND MostFrequent.bar = s1.bar GROUP BY b1.name ORDER BY COUNT(f1.drinker)
